title_de: Student engagement as a catalyst for systemic change
title_en: Student engagement as a catalyst for systemic change
description_de: How institutional change can transform entire systems, and why we should make better use of this opportunity. Universities serve thousands of meals every day. We’re making them vegan. How can other institutions do the same?
